meta.title: Data inventory
meta.description: The personal-data fields FOA keeps and their purposes and retention periods.

adminPrivacy.title: Data inventory
adminPrivacy.lead: Review how long FOA keeps personal data, the legal holds in force, and each personal-data field by its database table. Retention periods are pending confirmation with counsel.

inventory.title: Personal data fields
inventory.lead: Every column of personal data, with why FOA keeps it and for how long by default.
inventory.subject: Data subject

subjectKinds.author: Post author
subjectKinds.donor: Person or organisation who gave a donation
subjectKinds.guardian_contact: Guardian contact recorded for the participant
subjectKinds.directory_listing: Organisation or person listed in the directory
subjectKinds.panel_member: Member of a school judging panel
subjectKinds.held_subject: Account, participant or institution under the hold

periods.institutions: While the institution takes part, then 3 years after its last competition
periods.directoryListings: While the listing is in the directory, then 3 years after it is withdrawn, rejected or last changed
periods.coordinatorInvitations: 90 days after the invitation is accepted, withdrawn or expires
periods.coordinatorInvitationLinks: Until the invitation is accepted, withdrawn or expires
periods.safeguardingReports: While the report is open, then 7 years after it is resolved or until the child concerned turns 25, whichever is later
periods.breachRecords: While the breach is open, then 5 years after the breach is closed
periods.posts: While the post exists. Deleted with it

financialRecords.payments: 8 years after the end of the financial year of the payment
financialRecords.ledger: Kept in the append-only ledger for at least 8 years after the end of the financial year

periods.ledgerCategories: Kept with the ledger category, including after it is deactivated
periods.registrations: While the institution takes part, then 3 years after the competition ends
periods.guardians: While a linked child's profile exists, then 1 year. A guardian with no child is deleted with their account

guardianInvitations.invitation: 30 days after the invitation is accepted, withdrawn or expires
guardianInvitations.request: 30 days after the request is accepted, withdrawn or expires. An accepted request's guardian is then on the guardian record

periods.participants: Until 3 years after the last competition the participant (a school's student, or an adult on their own) was registered for
periods.expiredSessions: While the session lasts, then 30 days after it expires
periods.expiredVerifications: Until the code or link is used or expires, then 1 day at most
periods.auditLog: Kept: the audit log is append-only, and only the database owner can remove entries
periods.capturedMessages: 30 days after the message was captured
periods.messageDeliveries: 365 days after the message was queued
periods.readInboxItems: 365 days after the person reads it. Unread messages stay while the account is open
periods.dispatchedOutbox: 30 days after the job ran. A job that failed stays until staff resolve it
periods.rateLimitWindows: Until its window ends (at most a day). The next request removes it

consentRecords.general: Kept as the proof of each consent given or withdrawn, while the person takes part and as long as FOA may need to show it
consentRecords.competition: While the consent applies, then 3 years

periods.staffRecords: While the record exists. Cleared when the staff member's account is deleted
periods.cmsRevisionAuthorship: Kept with the revision, including after the staff account is deleted
periods.cmsRevisionContent: Kept with the revision. Published revisions are immutable
periods.consentDocumentAuthorship: Kept with the published consent version, including after the staff account is deleted
periods.consentDocumentContent: Kept with the published consent version, which is immutable
periods.files: While the file is kept: as long as the record it belongs to (an entry, a proof, a post)
periods.contactMessages: While the message is open, then {months} months after it is closed
periods.guardianInvitationLinks: Until the invitation is accepted, withdrawn or expires
periods.signedConsentForms: While the consent applies, then 3 years. For forms that did not grant consent, 3 years after closure
periods.consentLinkContacts: 90 days after the link is answered, revoked or expires
periods.consentLinkSecrets: Until the link is used, revoked or expires
periods.entryMedia: Until 90 days after the competition ends
periods.entryUploadGrants: Until the upload URL expires after 10 minutes and cleanup runs
periods.entryPendingText: Until the replacement passes, fails or is superseded
periods.announcements: While the competition's records are kept
periods.donationRecords: 8 years after the end of the financial year of the donation
periods.campaigns: While the campaign's records are kept
periods.releasedLegalHolds: While the hold is in force, then 365 days after it is released
periods.volunteerApplications: 365 days after a declined or withdrawn application closes. An approved application stays while the person volunteers
periods.adoptionApplications: 2 years after the application closes. One behind a published success story stays while the story is up
periods.privacyRequests: While the request is open, then 3 years after it is closed
periods.erasureRecords: Kept as the proof of an erasure, so it can be done again if a backup is restored

account.access_token: A sign-in provider's access token for the person, when one is used
account.account_id: The person's id at the sign-in provider (their own account id for email codes)
account.id_token: A sign-in provider's identity token, which carries the person's name and email
account.password: A password hash, if a password sign-in is ever turned on (none today)
account.refresh_token: A sign-in provider's refresh token for the person, when one is used
account.user_id: Links a sign-in method to the person's account

announcement.help_contacts_ciphertext: Provides the help contacts named in a competition's announcement
announcement.created_by: Records which competition manager wrote the announcement
announcement.sent_by: Records which competition manager sent the announcement

campaign.created_by: Records which community manager wrote the campaign
campaign.sent_by: Records which community manager sent the campaign

campaign_recipient.user_id: Records who a campaign message went to, so a withdrawal by its link reaches them
campaign_recipient.bases: Records whose consent each campaign message rested on: the recipient's own or their child's

audit_log.actor_user_id: Records which account took the action
audit_log.after: The changed fields after the action: ids and values, never a whole row
audit_log.before: The changed fields before the action: ids and values, never a whole row
audit_log.entity_id: Names the record acted on, which is a person's account or profile for some actions
audit_log.ip: The network address the action came from, to look into misuse
audit_log.user_agent: The browser the action came from, to look into misuse

breach_fan_out.after_user_id: Account cursor for resuming a breach notice job, cleared on completion

breach_notification.recipient_user_id: Shows who was told of the breach, about themselves or a child they look after, so each person is told once
breach_notification.guardian_profile_ids: Child profiles used to recheck a queued notice's guardian links, cleared when that channel settles

breach_record.title_ciphertext: A short label for the breach in the log, which may identify someone (encrypted)
breach_record.impact_ciphertext: What happened and what it means for the people affected, which may name them (encrypted)
breach_record.authority_reference_ciphertext: The reference the authority gave a breach notice filed by hand, to follow it up with them (encrypted)
breach_record.lead_user_id: Records which member of staff recorded and leads the response

breach_timeline_event.note_ciphertext: Staff notes over the breach's life, and why it closed without a notice, which may name people (encrypted)
breach_timeline_event.author_user_id: Records which member of staff made each change to the breach

breach_unreachable.subject_id: Lists the accounts and child profiles a notice couldn't reach (no account, or a child with no guardian), so staff can reach them another way

captured_message.body_html: A captured message's words as sent, which may hold the person's name or code
captured_message.body_text: A captured message's words, which may hold the person's name or code
captured_message.subject: A captured message's subject, which may name the person
captured_message.to_address: Where a captured message would have gone (local runs and previews only)

cms_post.author_name: The byline a post shows, as its editor typed it (optional)
cms_post.body: The text of the post, which may name or describe a person
cms_post.created_by: Records which content manager started the post
cms_post.easy_read: The easy-read summary, which may name or describe a person
cms_post.excerpt: The summary of the post, which may name or describe a person
cms_post.seo_title: The title shown in search results, which may name a person
cms_post.slug: The post's URL segment, which may include a person's name from the title
cms_post.title: The post's title, which may name a person
cms_post.updated_by: Records which content manager last changed the post

cms_post_image.alt: The image description, which may name or describe a person

cms_revision.body: The page's text and facts, including the grievance officer's name and email in Site facts
cms_revision.created_by_user_id: Records who wrote a page revision
cms_revision.published_by_user_id: Records who published a page revision

competition.created_by_user_id: Records which competition manager created the competition

competition_award_scheme.updated_by_user_id: Records who last changed a competition's prizes

competition_consent_document.attached_by_user_id: Records who attached a consent document to a competition

competition_fee.updated_by_user_id: Records who last changed a competition's fee

conduct_certification.certified_by_user_id: Identifies who certified that the competition was run in the school according to FOA’s guidelines

consent_document.body: The published consent text, which may name a person or include their contact details
consent_document.published_by_user_id: Records who published a consent document

consent_event.competition_id: Identifies the competition to which the consent applies
consent_event.giver_user_id: Says who gave or withdrew the consent: the person, or a child's guardian
consent_event.subject_id: Says whose consent it is: an account or a child's profile
consent_event.consent_form_id: Links a consent decision to the signed evidence of what the guardian agreed to
consent_event.consent_link_id: Links a recorded consent to the guardian's code link evidence
consent_event.giver_contact_hash: Identifies the verified consent giver without storing the contact in the consent log
consent_event.reviewer_user_id: Identifies who verified the signed evidence for this consent

consent_form.file_asset_id: Locates the private scan bearing the guardian's name and signature
consent_form.participant_profile_id: Identifies the enrolled student whose signed form FOA reviewed
consent_form.competition_id: Identifies the competition covered by the guardian's signed form
consent_form.institution_registration_id: Connects the signed form to the student's school registration for review and coordinator access
consent_form.uses: Records the public uses the guardian marked on the signed form
consent_form.documents: Preserves the exact consent document versions reviewed for the guardian's choices
consent_form.uploaded_by_user_id: Identifies the coordinator who submitted the form
consent_form.reviewed_by_user_id: Identifies the authorised reviewer who made the decision
consent_form.rejection_note: Explains how the coordinator can correct the submission. Staff are asked to leave out personal details

consent_form_upload.file_asset_id: Identifies the private scan upload bound to the student's enrolment
consent_form_upload.registration_id: Restricts a signed-form upload to the enrolled student it was requested for

consent_link.contact_ciphertext: Delivers the consent link and one-time code to the guardian
consent_link.contact_hash: Identifies the normalised delivery contact without reading it
consent_link.token_ciphertext: Builds the guardian's link when the message is delivered
consent_link.token_hash: Finds the link and recognises previously used or revoked links
consent_link.code_hash: Verifies the one-time code sent to the guardian contact
consent_link.session_token_hash: Binds the answer session to the browser which verified the code
consent_link.answers: Records the public uses the guardian gave or declined on the link
consent_link.offered_uses: Records the document versions shown for the guardian's choices
consent_link.participant_profile_id: Identifies the student whose choices the link records
consent_link.student_registration_id: Keeps the link tied to this student's school enrolment
consent_link.institution_registration_id: Scopes the student's link to the school's registration
consent_link.competition_id: Identifies the competition for which the guardian answered
consent_link.sent_by_user_id: Records the coordinator who issued the guardian link

contact_message.assigned_to_user_id: Records which member of staff is handling the message
contact_message.email: Where staff reply, and where the acknowledgement goes
contact_message.ip_hash: A keyed hash of the sender's network, never the address, to spot repeated abuse of the form
contact_message.message: What the sender asked or told FOA, so staff can answer
contact_message.name: Lets staff address the sender when they reply
contact_message.organisation: Tells staff which school or organisation wrote, when the sender gave one
contact_message.subject: Tells staff at a glance what the message is about

contact_note.author_user_id: Records which member of staff wrote the note
contact_note.body: What staff noted while handling the message

entry.code: Identifies the work when a participant asks FOA about an entry
entry.registration_id: Links the entry to its confirmed competition registration
entry.participant_profile_id: Links the work to the participant and the person authorised to view it
entry.title: Displays the name the participant gave the work
entry.description: Describes the work for the participant and authorised reviewers
entry.statement: Lets the participant explain the work in their own words
entry.created_by_user_id: Records which participant or guardian first uploaded the work

entry_file.id: Identifies which upload attempt an entry notice is about
entry_file.entry_id: Associates each upload attempt with the participant's entry
entry_file.file_asset_id: Links to privately stored artwork and the safe copies made from it
entry_file.uploaded_by_user_id: Records who uploaded each version of the work
entry_file.pending_text: Keeps a replacement's proposed text with the image being checked
entry_file.receipt_title: Keeps the adult participant's receipt tied to the submitted title
entry_file.essay_body: Keeps the essay a participant typed as their entry, for review and judging

entry_verification.entry_id: Connect the verification decision to the submitted entry.
entry_verification.reason_text: Explain to the participant or coordinator what needs to be corrected.
entry_verification.decided_by_user_id: Record the verifier responsible for the decision.

entry_transition.entry_id: Associates a change in status with the participant's entry
entry_transition.entry_file_id: Shows which upload caused a change in the entry's status
entry_transition.actor_user_id: Records which user acted when the entry changed status

entry_upload_grant.file_asset_id: Associates the short-lived grant with the uploader's staged file
entry_upload_grant.registration_id: Limits the grant to the authorised registration
entry_upload_grant.upload_key: Locates the staged object to clear when the grant expires

file_asset.owner_user_id: Says who uploaded the file, so only they and staff reach it
file_asset.storage_key: Locates the stored file, such as an entry's private original or a signed form's scan, including quarantined uploads

file_derivative.file_asset_id: Links a metadata-stripped copy to the uploaded file it came from
file_derivative.storage_key: Locates a metadata-stripped copy, such as the one shown for a live entry image

form_rate_limit.key_hash: A keyed hash of the network or address sending a public form, never the value

guardian.adult_declared_at: When the guardian declared they are 18 or older and the child's parent or lawful guardian
guardian.full_name_ciphertext: Names the parent or guardian who looks after a child, to the child and to FOA (encrypted)
guardian.phone_ciphertext: Reaches a child's parent or guardian about the child, if they gave a phone (encrypted)
guardian.phone_hash: A keyed hash of the guardian's phone, to find it without reading it
guardian.user_id: Links the guardian's declaration to their account, so only they manage their children
guardian.verified_at: When the guardian confirmed the declaration with a one-time code sent to them

guardian_invitation.accepted_by_user_id: Records which account accepted the invitation as the teen's own, or a teen's guardian request as their guardian (#81)
guardian_invitation.contact_ciphertext: The email a guardian invited their teen to an own login at, or a teen gave for the guardian they asked (#81), to send the link (encrypted)
guardian_invitation.contact_hash: A keyed hash of the invited email, to check that the teen or guardian accepting signed in with it
guardian_invitation.guardian_id: Says which guardian sent the invitation, or accepted a teen's request
guardian_invitation.invitee_name_ciphertext: The name a teen gave for the parent or guardian they asked FOA to contact, to greet them in the request (encrypted)
guardian_invitation.participant_profile_id: Says which child the invitation or request is about
guardian_invitation.relationship: How a teen says the person they named is related to them, shown to that person to confirm
guardian_invitation.requested_by_user_id: Links a guardian request to the teen who asked, so their held registrations are released to the guardian who accepts
guardian_invitation.token_ciphertext: The invitation link's token, to build the link when the message is sent (encrypted)

guardian_link.guardian_id: Says which guardian looks after the child
guardian_link.participant_profile_id: Says which child the guardian looks after
guardian_link.relationship: Says whether the guardian is the child's parent or legal guardian

inbox_item.body: What FOA told the person in the app, which may name them or their child
inbox_item.title: What FOA told the person in the app, which may name them or their child
inbox_item.user_id: Says whose in-app message it is
inbox_item.title_ciphertext: Shows the recipient the rendered announcement title
inbox_item.body_ciphertext: Shows the recipient the announcement instructions and help contacts

institution.contact_email: Reaches the institution's office about its registration
institution.contact_phone: Reaches the institution's office about its registration
institution.created_by: Links the institution to its authorised person, who becomes its admin
institution.principal_email_ciphertext: Lets FOA staff confirm the registration with the principal (encrypted)
institution.principal_name: Names the head of the institution FOA verifies it with
institution.principal_phone_ciphertext: Lets FOA staff confirm the registration with the principal (encrypted)
institution.status_reason: Records the reason staff gave for the institution decision
institution.verified_by: Records which FOA staff member verified the institution

directory_listing.slug: Gives the listing its public address, made from its name
directory_listing.name: Names the organisation, or the rescuer or foster caregiver, on the directory
directory_listing.description: Says what the listing does, in its own words
directory_listing.address_ciphertext: Lets FOA staff verify where the listing works; never public (encrypted)
directory_listing.city: Shows people roughly where the listing works
directory_listing.state: Shows people roughly where the listing works
directory_listing.pin_code: Shows people roughly where the listing works, and lets them search by distance
directory_listing.contact_phone_ciphertext: Lets FOA reach the listing, and people too if it chose to show it (encrypted)
directory_listing.contact_email_ciphertext: Lets FOA reach the listing, and people too if it chose to show it (encrypted)
directory_listing.website: Points people to the listing's own site, if it chose to show it
directory_listing.public_contact_fields: Records which contacts the listing chose to show the public
directory_listing.status_reason: Records the reason for the listing's latest status change
directory_listing.owner_user_id: Links the listing to the person who registered it, its first representative
directory_listing.status_changed_by_user_id: Records who last changed the listing's status

adoption_listing.state: Shows people roughly where an animal for adoption is, and lets them filter by it
adoption_listing.city: Shows people roughly where an animal for adoption is, and lets them filter by it
adoption_listing.city_key: Matches the city filter without regard to case
adoption_listing.pin_code: Shows people roughly where an animal for adoption is, and lets them filter by it
adoption_listing.created_by_user_id: Records which representative wrote the adoption listing

institution_invitation.accepted_by_user_id: Records which account accepted the invitation
institution_invitation.identifier_ciphertext: The email or mobile number a coordinator invitation goes to (encrypted)
institution_invitation.identifier_hash: Matches the invitee's account, and a second invitation to the same person, without storing the address readably
institution_invitation.invited_by_user_id: Records which authorised person sent the invitation
institution_invitation.revoked_by_user_id: Records which authorised person withdrew the invitation
institution_invitation.token_ciphertext: The invitation link's secret, so the message can carry it (encrypted)

institution_registration.registered_by: Records which coordinator or authorised person registered the institution for the competition
institution_registration.participation_declared_by_user_id: Identifies who declared that the institution authorises participation and judging

ledger_account.name: The finance category name, which may name a person
ledger_account.public_label: The public label for the category, which may name a person

ledger_line.memo: Explains a journal line and may name a counterparty

ledger_posting.created_by_user_id: Identifies the finance user who entered or reversed a posting
ledger_posting.description: Describes the entry and may name a counterparty

ledger_period.locked_by_user_id: Identifies the finance user who approved locking the month
ledger_period.last_unlocked_by_user_id: Identifies the finance user who approved the latest reopening of the month
ledger_period.last_unlock_reason: Finance's reason for reopening a locked month, which may name a person

ledger_budget.created_by_user_id: Identifies the finance user who first set the budget
ledger_budget.updated_by_user_id: Identifies the finance user who last changed the budget

finance_approval.requested_by_user_id: Identifies the finance user who asked for an operation that needs a second approver
finance_approval.decided_by_user_id: Identifies the finance user who approved, rejected or cancelled the request
finance_approval.payload: What the operation will do once approved, such as a manual entry's narration, which may name a counterparty
finance_approval.decision_reason: Finance's reason for rejecting the request, which may name a person

message_delivery.user_id: Says who a message was sent to
message_delivery.contact_hash: A keyed hash of the email or phone that deduplicates external deliveries across retries
message_delivery.recipient_hashes: Keyed hashes of a recipient's known addresses reconcile a contact delivery if their contact changes before a retry
message_delivery.recipient_account_hash: A keyed hash of the recipient's account reconciles a delivery if their address changes before a retry

message_template.updated_by_user_id: Records who last changed a message template

notification_preference.email: Whether the person wants optional messages by email
notification_preference.sms: Whether the person wants optional messages by text
notification_preference.user_id: Links message choices to the person's account

offline_payment.proof_file_asset_id: The scan or photo of the cheque, transfer advice or cash receipt; a cheque shows the payer's account number and signature. Only finance and staff admins open it
offline_payment.recorded_by_user_id: Who in finance recorded the offline payment, so FOA can answer for it
offline_payment.reference: The cheque number, bank transfer reference or FOA cash receipt finance recorded a payment with, so the money can be traced to the payer's bank

otp_rate_limit.key_hash: A keyed hash of the email, phone or network asking for sign-in codes, never the value

outbox.aggregate_id: The ids a background job works on, which can be a person's account or profile
outbox.last_error: Why a background job failed, which may quote a record it read
outbox.payload: The ids a background job works on, which can be a person's account or profile

participant_profile.address_ciphertext: Where certificates or artwork go back to, when it differs from the school (encrypted)
participant_profile.city: Locates the participant for regional rounds and reports
participant_profile.country: Where an adult on their own lives, so their postal code reads right and FOA reports by country
participant_profile.created_by: Records which coordinator or authorised person first entered the student
participant_profile.dob_ciphertext: Places the participant in an age group on the competition's cut-off date, keeps an adult registering on their own from being a minor, and tells a guardian's child under 13 (no login) from a teen (own login) (encrypted)
participant_profile.email_ciphertext: Reaches an adult student about their entry (encrypted)
participant_profile.full_name: Names the participant (a school's student, an adult on their own, or a guardian's child) on lists, entries and certificates
participant_profile.grade: Shows the student's class or year on the school's list
participant_profile.guardian_email_ciphertext: Reaches a minor's parent or guardian about the entry (encrypted)
participant_profile.guardian_name_ciphertext: Names a minor's parent or guardian to contact (encrypted)
participant_profile.guardian_phone_ciphertext: Reaches a minor's parent or guardian about the entry (encrypted)
participant_profile.guardian_relationship: Says whether the contact is the minor's parent or legal guardian
participant_profile.identity_hash: A keyed hash of the name and date of birth that spots the same student entered twice, without reading either
participant_profile.login_user_id: Links a guardian's 13- to 17-year-old child to their own login, so they take part themselves
participant_profile.owner_user_id: Links an adult's own profile to their account, or a child's profile to the guardian who keeps it (#81), so only they see and act on it
participant_profile.participant_code: The FOA Participant ID that names an adult to FOA across competitions; never a way to sign in
participant_profile.phone_ciphertext: Reaches an adult student, or an adult registered on their own, about their entry (encrypted)
participant_profile.pin_code: Locates the participant for regional rounds and reports (an adult abroad gives their postal code)
participant_profile.school_name: The school or college an adult on their own names, if any, so FOA can invite it to take part
participant_profile.state: Locates the participant for regional rounds and reports
participant_profile.student_ref: The school's own roll number, so the school recognises the student and FOA spots the same student entered twice

payment_batch.payer_user_id: Records who paid an institution's fees, or an adult their own (#78), so the receipt reaches them and FOA can answer a query about the payment

payment_review_case.resolution_reason: Why staff accepted, refunded or kept a payment in review: free text that may name the payer or what they said
payment_review_case.resolved_by_user_id: Who resolved a payment in review, so FOA can answer for it

donor.user_id: Links a donation to the signed-in account that gave it, so the donor can ask for a new receipt link
donor.name_ciphertext: The donor's name, or an organisation's contact person, printed on the receipt
donor.email_ciphertext: Where the donor's receipt link and messages about the donation go
donor.email_hash: Finds the donor's receipt when they ask for a new link with their email, without storing it readably
donor.organisation_name: A company's or CSR partner's name, printed on its receipt and shown in public only if it chose that

donation.wall_name: The name the donor chose to appear under on the public donor wall

receipt.snapshot: The receipt as issued, with the donor's name, frozen so it never changes

receipt_link.created_by_user_id: Who asked for a receipt link: the donor's account, or finance

refund.decided_by: Who in finance approved or rejected a refund, so FOA can answer for it
refund.decision_note: Finance's note on approving or rejecting a refund: free text the requester reads
refund.manual_recorded_by: Who in finance recorded paying a refund back by hand
refund.manual_reference: The transfer reference (UTR), cheque number or cash receipt of a refund paid back by hand
refund.reason: Why a refund was asked for, or why the system made it: free text that may name the payer or what they said
refund.requested_by: Who asked for a refund, so nobody decides their own request

registration.age_group_id: Records the age group assigned from the participant's date of birth and the competition's cut-off date
registration.registration_number: The unique number used to identify a participant's confirmed registration on rosters and in confirmations

rubric.created_by_user_id: Records who wrote a judging rubric
rubric.published_by_user_id: Records who published a judging rubric

safeguarding_incident_log.author_user_id: Records which safeguarding lead wrote each log entry
safeguarding_incident_log.body_ciphertext: The lead's notes and decisions over the case's life, as its record (encrypted)

safeguarding_report.assigned_to_user_id: Records which safeguarding lead is handling the report
safeguarding_report.description_ciphertext: What the reporter saw or was told, so the safeguarding lead can act (encrypted)
safeguarding_report.escalation_reference_ciphertext: The outside authority's reference, to follow the case with them (encrypted)
safeguarding_report.outcome_ciphertext: What the safeguarding lead decided and did, as the record of the case (encrypted)
safeguarding_report.reporter_contact_ciphertext: How to reach the reporter (email or phone), when they chose to be reached (encrypted)
safeguarding_report.reporter_is_child: Whether the reporter is a child, so the safeguarding lead can respond appropriately
safeguarding_report.reporter_name_ciphertext: Who reported, when they chose not to stay anonymous, to follow up (encrypted)
safeguarding_report.subject_age: The child's rough age, to judge urgency and how long to keep the report
safeguarding_report.subject_details_ciphertext: Who the concern is about (a name, a school, a username), to find the child (encrypted)

school_round.judging_attested_by_user_id: Records which coordinator attested the school judging
school_round.finalised_by_user_id: Records which coordinator finalised the school shortlist
school_round.closed_by_user_id: Records which competition manager closed an overdue school round on the school's behalf

school_round_pick.picked_by_user_id: Records which coordinator picked the entry for the school shortlist

school_round_transition.actor_user_id: Records which user acted when the school round changed status

school_round_panel_member.full_name: Names the person on the school judging panel the coordinator recorded
school_round_panel_member.designation: Shows the role of the person on the school judging panel

second_factor.credential_id: The passkey's id, to find it when the person signs in with it
second_factor.label: The name the person gave their authenticator or passkey, which may name them or their device
second_factor.public_key: The passkey's public key, to check the person's signature
second_factor.totp_secret_sealed: The authenticator app's shared secret, sealed, to check its codes
second_factor.user_id: Links an authenticator app or passkey to its account

second_factor_lockout.user_id: Links a run of wrong second-factor codes to the account it locks

session.ip_address: The network address the person signed in from, to spot a sign-in they didn't make
session.token: The session's secret, which the browser's cookie carries
session.user_agent: The browser and device the person signed in with, shown so they recognise their sessions
session.user_id: Links the session to the signed-in account

setting.updated_by_user_id: Records which super admin last changed a setting

user.email: Signs the person in by email code and sends their messages
user.image: A profile picture's address, when the sign-in provider gives one
user.name: Greets the person and names them to staff
user.phone_ciphertext: Signs the person in by SMS code (encrypted)
user.phone_hash: A keyed hash of the person's phone, to find their account by it without reading it

user_role.granted_by_user_id: Records which super admin granted the role
user_role.user_id: Says which account holds the role

verification.identifier: A hash of the email sign-in identifier or a namespaced keyed hash of the phone number finds the recipient's verification even before they have an account. A namespaced guardian record ID locates codes for guardian confirmation.
verification.value: The hashed email code, keyed SMS code digest or keyed guardian confirmation code digest, stored with the count of failed attempts

legal_hold.subject_id: Names the account, participant or institution whose records are held
legal_hold.reason: Why FOA must keep the records, in the super admin's words (a claim, an inquiry)
legal_hold.placed_by_user_id: Records which super admin placed the hold
legal_hold.released_by_user_id: Records which super admin released the hold

adoption_application.applicant_user_id: Links the application to the person who applied, so they can follow it and hear what happens
adoption_application.participant_profile_id: The participant profile the date of birth came from, when the person had one
adoption_application.date_of_birth_ciphertext: The date of birth the adult-only rule was checked against when the person applied (encrypted)
adoption_application.phone_ciphertext: The applicant's mobile, shared with the listing organisation once the coordinator puts them in touch (encrypted)
adoption_application.address_ciphertext: The applicant's postal address, shared with the listing organisation once the coordinator puts them in touch (encrypted)
adoption_application.answers_ciphertext: What the applicant said about their home, other animals and experience, to judge the match (encrypted)
adoption_application.contact_sharing_consent_id: The applicant's consent to share their contact details with the listing organisation
adoption_application.outcome_reason_ciphertext: Why the coordinator recorded the application as not matched or declined, for staff only (encrypted)
adoption_application.decided_by_user_id: The adoption coordinator who last moved the application

adoption_story.body: The adopter's success story, shown on the public stories page only while they consent
adoption_story.consent_event_id: The adopter's consent to share the story
adoption_story.published_by_user_id: The adoption coordinator who published the story

volunteer_application.applicant_user_id: Links the application to the person who applied, so they can follow it and FOA can grant them the volunteer role
volunteer_application.participant_profile_id: The participant profile the date of birth came from: a teen's, kept by their guardian, or an adult's own
volunteer_application.date_of_birth_ciphertext: The date of birth the age rules were checked against when the person applied (encrypted)
volunteer_application.interests: The areas the person offered to help with, so a community manager can place them
volunteer_application.availability: When the person said they are free each week, and their note about it
volunteer_application.guardian_user_id: The verified guardian who approved or declined a 14- to 17-year-old's application
volunteer_application.safeguarding_consent_id: The safeguarding declaration the approval rested on
volunteer_application.conduct_consent_id: The code of conduct acceptance the approval rested on
volunteer_application.decline_reason_ciphertext: Why a community manager declined, as the applicant was told (encrypted)
volunteer_application.decided_by_user_id: The community manager who approved or declined the application

privacy_request.subject_id: Names the account or child's profile the request is about
privacy_request.requested_by_user_id: Records who filed the request, so they can follow it and are told the outcome
privacy_request.correction_details_ciphertext: What the person says is wrong and should be corrected, in their words
privacy_request.assigned_to_user_id: Records which grievance officer is answering the request
privacy_request.rejection_reason_ciphertext: Why the grievance officer refused the request, as the person is told
privacy_request.resolution_ciphertext: What the grievance officer corrected, as the person is told
privacy_request.erasure_approved_by_user_id: Records which grievance officer approved the erasure

privacy_request_note.body_ciphertext: The grievance officer's internal notes on the request
privacy_request_note.author_user_id: Records which grievance officer wrote the note

erasure_record.subject_id: Names the account or child's profile that was erased
erasure_record.user_ids: Names every account the erasure covered, so it can be done again after a backup is restored
erasure_record.profile_ids: Names every participant profile the erasure covered, for the same reason

status.enforcedTitle: The daily run removes expired records
status.enforced: At 02:15 IST it deletes or anonymises expired records outside a legal hold and writes the counts in the audit log.
status.counting: It records in the audit log how many records it would remove, and removes none. A super admin turns on “Delete expired records” in the settings once FOA's counsel has confirmed the periods.
status.settingsLink: Change the periods in the settings

policies.title: Retention policies
policies.lead: FOA's counsel still needs to confirm these periods.
policies.caption: Retention policies, with what they keep and how long
policies.floor: A legal floor applies: no setting can shorten it.

expiredVerifications.name: Expired sign-in codes
expiredVerifications.rule: Deleted {days, plural, one {# day} other {# days}} after the code or link expires.

expiredSessions.name: Expired sessions
expiredSessions.rule: Deleted, with the network address and browser they recorded, {days, plural, one {# day} other {# days}} after the session expires.

capturedMessages.name: Captured test messages
capturedMessages.rule: Deleted {days, plural, one {# day} other {# days}} after capture. Only local runs and previews capture messages.

messageDeliveries.name: Message log
messageDeliveries.rule: Deleted {days, plural, one {# day} other {# days}} after the message was queued.

readInboxItems.name: Read in-app messages
readInboxItems.rule: Deleted {days, plural, one {# day} other {# days}} after the person reads them. Unread ones stay while the account is open.

quarantinedFiles.name: Quarantined files
quarantinedFiles.rule: The upload and its stored object are deleted {days, plural, one {# day} other {# days}} after quarantine. A payment's proof stays with its payment record.

dispatchedOutbox.name: Finished background jobs
dispatchedOutbox.rule: Deleted {days, plural, one {# day} other {# days}} after the job ran. A failed job stays until staff resolve it.

coordinatorInvitationLinks.name: Expired coordinator invitation links
coordinatorInvitationLinks.rule: The link is cleared on acceptance or withdrawal, or {days, plural, one {# day} other {# days}} after an unanswered invitation expires.

guardianInvitationLinks.name: Expired guardian invitation links
guardianInvitationLinks.rule: The link is cleared on acceptance or withdrawal, or {days, plural, one {# day} other {# days}} after an unanswered invitation expires.

coordinatorInvitations.name: Closed coordinator invitations
coordinatorInvitations.rule: Deleted {days, plural, one {# day} other {# days}} after the invitation is accepted, withdrawn or expires.

guardianInvitations.name: Closed guardian invitations and requests
guardianInvitations.rule: Deleted {days, plural, one {# day} other {# days}} after the invitation or request is accepted, withdrawn or expires.

orphanedProfiles.name: Profiles left without an account
orphanedProfiles.rule: Deleted at the next run once the owner's account is gone, if the person never entered a competition.

contactMessages.name: Contact messages
contactMessages.rule: Kept while the message is open. The message and its staff notes are deleted {months, plural, one {# month} other {# months}} after it closes.

safeguardingReports.name: Safeguarding reports
safeguardingReports.rule: Deleted, with their incident log, 7 years after they are resolved or when the child turns 25, whichever is later.

breachRecords.name: Breach log
breachRecords.rule: Kept while the breach is open, then deleted, with its timeline and notices, 5 years after it is closed.

volunteerApplications.name: Closed volunteer applications
volunteerApplications.rule: A declined or withdrawn application is deleted {days, plural, one {# day} other {# days}} after it closes. An approved one stays while the person volunteers.

adoptionApplications.name: Closed adoption applications
adoptionApplications.rule: A closed adoption application is deleted, with its success story, {days, plural, one {# day} other {# days}} after it closes. One whose story is published stays while the story is up.

financialRecords.name: Payment records
financialRecords.rule: The payer's details are removed {days, plural, one {# day} other {# days}} after the payment's last activity, and never before 8 years after the end of its financial year.

releasedLegalHolds.name: Released legal holds
releasedLegalHolds.rule: Kept while the hold is in force, then deleted {days, plural, one {# day} other {# days}} after it is released.

institutions.name: Institutions
institutions.rule: Kept while the institution takes part, then 3 years after its last competition. No daily job yet.

directoryListings.name: Directory listings
directoryListings.rule: Kept while the listing is in the directory, then 3 years after it is withdrawn, rejected or last changed. No daily job yet.

registrations.name: Institution registrations
registrations.rule: Kept while the institution takes part, then 3 years after the competition ends. No daily job yet.

participants.name: Participants
participants.rule: Kept until 3 years after the participant's last competition. No daily job yet.

guardians.name: Guardians
guardians.rule: Kept while a linked child's profile exists, then 1 year. A guardian with no child is deleted with their account.

staffRecords.name: Who on staff did what
staffRecords.rule: Kept with the record, and cleared when the staff member's account is deleted.

auditLog.name: Audit log
auditLog.rule: Kept in the append-only audit log. Only the database owner can remove entries.

consentRecords.name: Consent records
consentRecords.rule: Kept as the proof of each consent given or withdrawn.

files.name: Uploaded files
files.rule: Kept as long as the record the file belongs to, such as an entry, proof or post. Flagged uploads follow the quarantine policy.

paymentProofs.name: Payment proofs
paymentProofs.rule: Kept with the payment record, including a proof the scanner quarantined.

rateLimitWindows.name: Rate limits
rateLimitWindows.rule: Removed by the next request once the window ends, within a day.

cmsRevisionAuthorship.name: Who wrote each post revision
cmsRevisionAuthorship.rule: Kept with the revision, including after the staff account is deleted.

cmsRevisionContent.name: Post revisions
cmsRevisionContent.rule: Kept with the revision. Published revisions are immutable.

consentDocumentAuthorship.name: Who published each consent version
consentDocumentAuthorship.rule: Kept with the published consent version, including after the staff account is deleted.

consentDocumentContent.name: Consent versions
consentDocumentContent.rule: Kept with the published consent version, which is immutable.

signedConsentForms.name: Signed consent forms
signedConsentForms.rule: While the consent applies, then 3 years. For forms that did not grant consent, 3 years after closure. No daily job yet.

consentLinkContacts.name: Consent link contacts
consentLinkContacts.rule: 90 days after the link is answered, revoked or expires. No daily job yet.

consentLinkSecrets.name: Consent link codes
consentLinkSecrets.rule: Until the link is used, revoked or expires. Cleared by the consent module.

ledgerCategories.name: Ledger categories
ledgerCategories.rule: Kept with the ledger category, including after it is deactivated.

entries.name: Competition entries
entries.rule: 3 years after the competition ends. No daily job yet.

entryMedia.name: Entry images
entryMedia.rule: Until 90 days after the competition ends. No daily job yet.

entryUploadGrants.name: Entry upload grants
entryUploadGrants.rule: Until the upload URL expires after 10 minutes and cleanup runs.

entryPendingText.name: Pending entry text
entryPendingText.rule: Until the replacement passes, fails or is superseded.

announcements.name: Announcements
announcements.rule: While the competition's records are kept. No daily job yet.

donationRecords.name: Donations and receipts
donationRecords.rule: Kept as financial records until 8 years after the end of the donation's financial year. A receipt never changes once issued. No daily job yet.

campaigns.name: Campaigns
campaigns.rule: While the campaign's records are kept. No daily job yet.

privacyRequests.name: Closed privacy requests
privacyRequests.rule: Kept while the request is open, then deleted with the grievance officer's notes {days, plural, one {# day} other {# days}} after it closes.

erasureRecords.name: Erasure records
erasureRecords.rule: Kept as the proof of each erasure. They hold ids only, never a name or a contact.

holds.title: Legal holds in force
holds.lead: While a hold is in force, the daily run keeps every record about that account, participant or institution.
holds.subject: {type, select, user {Account} participant_profile {Participant} other {Institution}} {id}

form.title: Place a legal hold
form.idHint: Enter the UUID of the account, participant profile or institution.
form.reasonHint: Keep this brief. The reason is visible to staff admins.
form.invalid_input: Check the subject type, UUID and reason before submitting.
form.subject_not_found: No subject of that type has this ID.
form.already_held: A hold is already in force for this subject.
form.not_found: This hold could not be found.
form.already_released: This hold has already been released.
form.forbidden: Only a super admin can place or release a legal hold.
